jobs.title: Senior Applied Data Scientist
jobs.description:
About Clair

If you can send your friends money in seconds, why does it still take your employer two weeks to send your paycheck?

At Clair, we are on a mission to create financial freedom for America's workers by giving them a digital banking platform that allows them to get paid as soon as they clock out of work. But we're not just another digital bank or on-demand pay provider. We meet Americans at their place of work by embedding our products within the scheduling, workforce management, and payroll apps they already use every day.

Learn more about us at getclair.com/about

About The Role

As an Applied Data Scientist on Clair’s Data Science team, you’ll be responsible for developing and maintaining the next generation of credit models and predictive systems that power Clair’s financial products. You’ll shape how millions of hourly workers access affordable credit, leveraging cutting-edge data science to assess risk, predict repayment, and optimize credit decisions.

We’re looking for someone who thrives at the intersection of data science, machine learning, and fintech, and who’s excited to translate messy, real-world data into clear, actionable intelligence. This role blends credit modeling with feature engineering — from designing new model features (including predictive features) based on user transaction data to deploying and monitoring production-ready ML models that drive critical product decisions.

To succeed, you’ll need a deep technical foundation in machine learning and statistical modeling, hands-on experience in model deployment, and strong communication skills to collaborate with engineers, product managers, and risk teams.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and maintain credit risk and repayment models that directly power Clair’s underwriting and decision systems.
Design and engineer predictive features using transaction-level data, including the prediction of user income flows, spending, and repayment behaviors.
Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy, monitor, and optimize models in production environments using AWS and Snowflake ML Platform.
Build prototypes of new modeling methodologies and present them to stakeholders for evaluation and feedback.
Investigate and analyze credit performance, identifying root causes of model drift or unexpected repayment behavior.
Partner cross-functionally with product, risk, and engineering teams to turn data insights into product improvements and credit strategy refinements.
Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Stay current on best practices and emerging techniques in credit modeling, explainable AI, and financial ML systems.

Minimum Qualifications

5+ years of professional experience in data science and machine learning.
Proven track record of leading end-to-end data science projects — from research and model development to deployment and monitoring.
Experience building and productionizing credit or risk assessment models.
Strong proficiency in Python and familiarity with modern ML libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, XGBoost, etc.).
Strong command of SQL and experience working with large transactional and time-series datasets.
Strong communication skills and ability to translate complex findings into actionable insights.
Experience working with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced production environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in fintech or credit risk modeling.
Experience with cloud-based machine learning environments (AWS, Azure, Snowflake ML Platform, etc.).
Familiarity with model explainability techniques and compliance requirements in financial modeling.
Experience working with time-series analysis and modeling, including forecasting, trend detection, and temporal feature engineering

Additional Details

Location:
This is a hybrid position based in New York City; you will be expected to come into the office at least three days a week (Tuesdays, Wednesdays, & Thursdays), with additional days on occasion for client meetings.

Compensation:
The annual base salary for this role is $190,000-$200,000. The base pay for this role is determined using many factors, such as education, skills, and experience, and is reflective of Clair Series stage and size. Base pay is only one part of Clair’s competitive total compensation package, which includes equity, benefits, and additional perks. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

At 10x Genomics, accelerating our understanding of biology is more than a mission for us. It is a commitment. This is the century of biology, and the breakthroughs we make now have the potential to change the world.

We enable scientists to advance their research, allowing them to address scientific questions they did not even know they could ask. Our tools have enabled fundamental discoveries across biology including cancer, immunology, and neuroscience.

About The Team And Role

The Strategic Insights & Analytics team sits at the intersection of data science and business strategy. We build the analytical representation of how the company operates and grows to support strategic decisions, our ultimate product. We treat this as an engineering discipline: grounding models in the scientific process, versioning in code repositories, and delivering as internal products that support consequential business decisions.

We are a team of high-agency, cross-disciplinary individuals who pursue the highest-leverage opportunities to deliver insights and analytics, wherever they sit in the business. We share ambition and conviction that one person can now deliver what used to take a team, and that historically fragmented, static, spreadsheet-driven models can now converge into a single unified analytical model of the company. We take pride in fully leveraging modern AI tools to build analytical products and inform strategic decisions end-to-end.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role. You will collaborate closely with senior business leaders and embed within teams across the organization to drive impact, then move on to the next highest-leverage problem.

What You Will Be Working On

Data and semantic foundations: defining and implementing customer and market segments across systems, enriching with telemetry and other data; developing versioned metric definitions and business context so people and AI reason over a shared model; improving our EDW and semantic layer (dbt, GitHub, Snowflake)
Customer, market, and growth models: modeling where growth comes from (new versus existing customers, by segment); activation, retention, expansion; cohort analysis; funnel conversion; sales/marketing/service capacity and effectiveness models
Forecasting and planning models: building territory, account, and instrument-level demand forecasts and LTV models; migrating planning models from spreadsheets to versioned models in GitHub
Enablement and automation: unifying the business review cadence on standardized views tied to company goals; enabling self-serve analytics and insights; replacing manual work with agentic workflows
Stakeholder partnership: program managing cross-functional initiatives, translating ambiguous business needs from leaders into structured analytical products; communicating recommendations clearly

To be successful you will need

Education & experience: Bachelor’s or Master's degree in a quantitative discipline (Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science) or an MBA with a technical focus; 8+ years experience in data science, analytics, corporate strategy, business operations, management consulting, or similar roles using analytics and applied data science to solve complex business problems and drive strategic decisions
Analytical rigor: Hands-on depth in cohort and retention analysis, regression, time series, causal inference and experiment design, and supervised and unsupervised models; experience deploying machine learning models into production to solve commercial or operational problems
Technical proficiency: SQL and Python for data manipulation and predictive modeling; reflexively AI-first, with experience shipping working systems using AI coding tools (Claude Code or similar) and the aptitude to learn new tools quickly; supporting stack: Git, GitHub, Snowflake, dbt or similar, CI/CD tools, comfortable building code-based, version-controlled reporting and dashboards that replace legacy tools like Tableau or Power BI
Commercial acumen: Deep experience with sales processes and tools, specifically Salesforce CRM, quota and territory assignment, and the B2B enterprise demand generation funnel; you understand how a business makes money and can trace a commercial decision through to revenue, margin, and cash
High agency & product thinking: Extreme bias for action and comfort working in a fast-paced environment with ambiguous requirements; you assume AI can do something until proven otherwise, scope problems and verify your own work, and design for the end user
Communication skills: Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present technical work to senior management, sales leadership, and non-technical audiences and to influence cross-functional teams

About Revin

At Revin, our mission is to bring superintelligence to the built world. Millions of operators across Home Services, Construction, and Remodeling have been overlooked by the last wave of technology. We believe AI is the most transformational platform change in history, but the hard work lies in thoughtful, context-aware applications of this technology to the real world.

The Pathfinder Team is our elite group of field-deployed engineers. Each team member has previous founding experience, with fanatical customer obsession and a proven track record of operating and winning in uncharted territory.

Own customer interactions, collaborating closely with customer executives and Revin’s GTM team to ensure customer delight and grow enterprise deals

Don’t Work Here If

You wait for instructions instead of taking initiative
You want a safe, predictable 9-5. Expect 50+ hour work weeks. We are looking for fanatics who do not turn off. We are constantly chasing excellence, if that is not your goal, please do not apply

Significant upside through early ownership and career growth

About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the role:

We're hiring a DevRel Engineer to work inside the product teams building Vercel's agentic infrastructure: AI Gateway, Sandbox, and the primitives that come after them. You'll sit with product and engineering, build with these tools before anyone else can, and show the world what they make possible. You will report to the Head of AI Infrastructure and can be located anywhere.

If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday, even if the role is listed as remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

When applying, include a link to something you made that taught developers something, a talk, a repo, a post, a video. Applications without one will not be considered.

What you will do:

Build agents and applications on AI Gateway and Sandbox before they ship, then turn what you learn into demos, templates, and open source projects developers actually clone and run.
Teach developers how to build with agentic infrastructure through writing, talks, videos, and live coding. You set the canonical examples the ecosystem emulates.
Shape the products themselves. You sit in the same planning meetings as the PMs and engineers, and your job is to hit the rough edges first and make sure they get fixed before launch.
Own the important pieces of launches: example repos, launch demos, docs contributions, and the first wave of answers when developers start asking questions.
Bring the outside in: track how developers across the ecosystem are building agents, where they get stuck, and what they're reaching for that doesn't exist yet.

About you:

5+ years in engineering, DevRel, or DX roles, with software you can point to.
You've built and shipped AI applications or agents: you know tool calling, model routing, and sandboxed code execution from using them.
Strong TypeScript, and you're at home in the Next.js and AI SDK ecosystem.
You have a public body of work: talks, posts, open source, or videos.
You can take a half-finished API and produce a working demo and a clear explanation in the same week, often times the same day.
You've changed a product roadmap with developer feedback.

Bonus if you:

Maintain or contribute to an open source project other developers depend on.
Have spun up a microVM and have opinions on why isolation matters for agents.
Have shipped something real on Vercel with the AI SDK.

Competitive compensation package, including equity.
Inclusive Healthcare Package.

Flexible Time Off.

jobs.description:
Job Description

At American Express, AI is reshaping the future of commerce and redefining the experiences our commercial customers and card members expect. Within Amex Technology, we are building platforms, products, and governance that enable agentic AI systems to operate responsibly and at scale across the enterprise.

Our focus is on agentic AI development: designing intelligent, adaptive systems that can plan, reason, and act across complex workflows with appropriate levels of autonomy. These systems power autonomous workflows, decision support, and customer-facing experiences—while meeting the high standards for security, explainability, reliability, and compliance required in financial services.

We partner closely with product, design, and business teams to deliver agentic capabilities that reduce operational friction, improve decision-making, and transform how customers interact, transact, and grow.

The Role

As a Senior AI Engineer – Agentic AI, you will be a core builder responsible for turning complex, ambiguous problems into production-grade agentic systems that operate on real financial data, serve real customers, and meet real regulatory requirements.

You will work end to end: shaping solutions with product and design, building and shipping production code, and owning what you deliver after launch. The scope of this role spans customer-facing LLM-powered features, agentic systems that automate financial workflows, and internal AI capabilities that enable other engineers to build with AI safely and efficiently.

This is not a research-only role. We are looking for engineers who are comfortable operating with autonomy, exercising sound judgment, and pushing the technical envelope within the realities of a regulated financial environment.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

Design, build, and ship LLM-powered and agentic product features that change how customers manage their finances.
Build agentic AI systems that reason over context, invoke tools, take real actions, and recover gracefully from failure.
Architect and implement production-grade RAG pipelines over sensitive financial data, with strict requirements for correctness, auditability, and safety.
Contribute to shared AI infrastructure, including LLM services, agent orchestration frameworks, and evaluation and monitoring tooling, that scales agentic development across Amex Technology.
Own the systems you build in production, including reliability, latency, cost, and failure modes.
Work closely with product and design partners; engineers in this role are expected to think in terms of customer outcomes, not just technical execution.

Technical Environment

We don’t hire to a narrow checklist, but candidates should be comfortable operating in a modern, enterprise-scale environment with a strong emphasis on agentic AI.

Core engineering stack

Languages: Python, Go, TypeScript
Cloud and infrastructure: AWS and/or GCP, Kubernetes
APIs and services: REST, gRPC
Distributed systems: event-driven architectures, including Kafka

Agentic AI and ML

Commercial and open-source LLMs integrated into agentic workflows
Tooling for agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, vector storage, and evaluation
Strong schema, validation, and state management practices

AI-assisted development

Fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development workflows for design, implementation, testing, debugging, and refactoring
Thoughtful use of these tools while maintaining production-quality engineering standards
All systems are built to meet high standards for reliability, security, and auditability, reflecting the responsibility of deploying autonomous AI in a financial services environment.

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For

5+ years of software engineering experience, including meaningful production experience with LLMs or applied ML systems.
A track record of shipping AI-powered or agentic systems that real users depend on.
Strong engineering fundamentals across backend systems, APIs, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure.
Hands-on experience with modern LLM tooling and agentic patterns and architectures.
Fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development workflows.
Strong sense of ownership and sound technical judgment.
Comfort operating with ambiguity and turning it into shipped reliable product.
A strong product mindset and customer orientation.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building agentic systems in fintech or other regulated industries.
Experience as a founding engineer or early technical contributor in high-growth environments.
Demonstrated ability to ship technically complex systems in regulated contexts that customers actively rely on.
Meaningful open-source contributions, particularly in AI or developer tooling.

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Job Description

The Enterprise Technology Services organization partners with every part of the American Express business to power the company’s growth and innovation with trust and efficiency, and drive competitive differentiation with speed. We support the delivery and operations of technology, digital, and data capabilities, platforms, and services globally. Specifically, our team is responsible for the company’s technology engineering, architecture, and infrastructure, providing 24x7 support to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality experience for customers and colleagues. We also provide product management for core enterprise platforms, and lead technology risk and information security, enterprise data governance and platforms, digital product and design, and enterprise AI platforms on behalf of the company.

The Evaluation Engineer designs, develops, and maintains evaluation frameworks for AI and machine learning solutions, including LLM, RAG, agentic, and multimodal applications. This role translates business, product, risk, and governance requirements into measurable success criteria; builds automated and human-in-the-loop evaluation pipelines; and partners with cross-functional teams to ensure AI systems meet enterprise standards for quality, safety, reliability, compliance, latency, and cost.

Responsibilities

Mentors junior AI Engineers and cross-functional team of colleagues, fostering a culture of excellence and innovation
Integrates AI models into production systems in collaboration with cross-functional teams, ensuring effective integration into existing production systems
Maintains strict adherence to model governance, security, and compliance standards
Provides guidance and support to junior engineers, fostering professional growth and development within the team
Designs and implements AI/machine learning frameworks for data processing, focusing on prompt engineering and generative AI technologies
Collaborates with engineers to deliver scalable AI solutions by integrating models that meet both technical and business requirements
Translates business requirements into AI-driven technical solutions, ensuring that business needs are converted into actionable models and algorithms
Develops reusable Big Data pipelines and AI-based systems, ensuring efficiency and consistency in data processing and model deployment
Experiments with and deploys new natural language processing models to classify and analyze business-related text data, conducting research to improve text classification and analysis
Creates end-to-end machine learning operations pipelines for scalable model deployment, facilitating seamless deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of AI models
Collaborates and co-creates effectively with teams in product and the business to align technology initiatives with business objectives
Designs and operates scalable production AI systems, integrating ML models, LLMs, and intelligent services across multiple components
Leads development of AI capabilities such as robust inference services, retrieval pipelines (e.g., RAG), orchestration layers, and evaluation frameworks
Ensures AI systems adhere to enterprise standards for reliability, safety, explainability, observability, and compliance, mentoring others on best practices
Defines evaluation strategies, success criteria, benchmarks, and scorecards for LLM, RAG, agentic, and multimodal AI solutions across quality, safety, reliability, latency, and cost.
Builds automated evaluation pipelines using curated datasets, synthetic test generation, human review, model-based grading, and deterministic checks; validates evaluators for consistency and bias.
Establishes regression testing, release gates, and continuous evaluation to detect quality degradation, prompt or model drift, unsafe behavior, and changes introduced by models, data, tools, or orchestration.
Partners with product, engineering, risk, and governance teams to convert use-case requirements and policy expectations into measurable acceptance criteria and traceable evidence.
Performs failure analysis and communicates actionable findings, tradeoffs, and remediation priorities to engineering and business stakeholders.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Joining Amex Tech means discovering and shaping your contribution to something big. Here, you can work alongside talented tech teams and build a unique career with the Powerful Backing of American Express. With a range of opportunities to work with the latest technologies, and a commitment to back the broader engineering community through open source, our mission is to power your success. Because Amex Tech is powered by our technology, our culture, and our colleagues.

The Technology organization enables and accelerates the company’s growth strategies, delivering global capabilities and services in support of Amex’s customers and colleagues, while maintaining 24/7 servicing and availability to ensure uninterrupted, high-quality customer experience. Technology provides the foundation for everything we do in the company while driving differentiation through building and leveraging innovative technology and data insights.

The Enterprise AI Platform organization builds foundational capabilities that enable teams across American Express to develop and scale AI/ML and Generative AI products and experiences securely and responsibly.

Our team brings together talent and experience from Big Tech, AI research and academia, startups, and American Express, combining deep expertise and diverse perspectives with an entrepreneurial mindset and a passion for building. Together, we are focused on enabling American Express to operate as an AI-powered enterprise and deliver measurable business impact.

At American Express, AI is reshaping the future of commerce and redefining the experiences our commercial customers and card members expect. Within Amex Technology, we are building platforms, products, and governance that enable agentic AI systems to operate responsibly and at scale across the enterprise.

Our focus is on agentic AI development: designing intelligent, adaptive systems that can plan, reason, and act across complex workflows with appropriate levels of autonomy. These systems power autonomous workflows, decision support, and customer-facing experiences—while meeting the high standards for security, explainability, reliability, and compliance required in financial services.

We partner closely with product, design, and business teams to deliver agentic capabilities that reduce operational friction, improve decision-making, and transform how customers interact, transact, and grow.

As a Staff Data Engineer – Agentic AI, you will operate as a senior individual contributor within Amex Technology, helping define how agentic AI systems are designed, built, and operated across the company.

You will work at the intersection of agentic system architecture and hands-on execution: designing core frameworks, writing production code, reviewing critical designs, and guiding teams through complex technical decisions. This role does not include people management; your impact comes from technical leadership, sound judgment, and the ability to turn ambiguity into reliable, scalable agentic systems.

You will work closely with Product and UX partners to shape a shared vision for agentic AI experiences. While product teams own prioritization, Staff engineers are expected to actively influence what gets built and how agentic systems come together across teams.

This is an individual contributor, hands-on, deeply technical role with broad architectural ownership and high organizational impact; however, as the team grows, you will take on increasing responsibility for technical leadership and people development within the agentic AI space. Mentoring, developing and managing direct reports may be in scope for some of our opportunities.

Drive technical direction for agentic AI initiatives, influencing architecture patterns, autonomy boundaries, and system design.
Design, build, and operate production-grade agentic AI systems used across multiple products.
Own and evolve shared agentic AI capabilities, including:
Agent frameworks and orchestration layers
Planning, tool use, and memory strategies
Retrieval and grounding (RAG) pipelines
LLM infrastructure, inference, and model gateways
Evaluation, observability, and safety tooling for autonomous systems

Lead technical design reviews and help teams navigate tradeoffs involving autonomy, safety, reliability, scalability, and cost.
Partner across teams to deliver complex, cross-cutting agentic AI initiatives from concept to production.
Evaluate emerging models, techniques, and agentic patterns and translate them into practical, enterprise-ready improvements.
Mentor senior engineers and raise the technical bar for agentic AI development through example and influence.

Technical Environment

We don’t hire to a narrow checklist, but candidates should be comfortable operating in a modern, enterprise-scale engineering environment with a strong emphasis on agentic AI.

Core engineering stack

Languages: Python, Java, Go, TypeScript
APIs and RPC: REST, gRPC (and in some areas tRPC)
Cloud and infrastructure: AWS and/or GCP, Kubernetes
Distributed systems: event-driven architectures, including Kafka
Orchestration Frameworks: LangGraph, LangChain, AirFlow, etc

Agentic AI and ML

Integration of commercial and open-source LLMs into agentic workflows
Agent and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or CrewAI, with strong judgment about when to use frameworks versus building lighter-weight primitives
Model-level work using PyTorch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (embeddings, fine-tuning, inference tooling), with some exposure to TensorFlow
Strong schema, validation, and state management practices using tools such as Pydantic (Python) and Zod (TypeScript)

Across all systems, we emphasize evaluation, observability, safety, and reliability, reflecting the responsibility of deploying autonomous AI in a regulated, customer-facing environment.

Qualifications

12+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems + strong experience with LLM systems, agentic workflows or advanced ML infrastructure
Proven ownership of complex, cross-cutting agentic systems spanning multiple teams or products.
Strong engineering fundamentals across backend systems, APIs, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure.
Deep experience across the agentic AI stack, including planning, tool use, memory, and evaluation.
Fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development workflows.
Comfort operating in ambiguous problem spaces and translating them into shipped, reliable autonomous systems.
Ability to influence technical direction and align teams without formal authority.
Experience in workflow engines, async processing, queues, and streaming systems.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building agentic systems in fintech or other regulated industries.
Experience as a founding engineer or early technical leader in AI-driven products.
Demonstrated success delivering technically complex autonomous systems that customers actively rely on.
Meaningful contributions to open-source AI or agentic frameworks.
Familiarity with fine-tuning, model optimization and inference pipelines is a plus

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Agentic Infrastructure
jobs.description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the Role:

The next generation of software won’t just be used by people — it’ll be built and shipped by agents. Builds are where that happens, and they’re the beating heart of Vercel. Whether an idea starts in v0, in an agent, or in an engineer’s editor, every customer builds — and millions of builds flow through our systems every day.

As an engineer on the Agentic Infrastructure team, you’ll take ownership of the systems that carry that work at scale. You won’t just contribute features — you’ll be responsible for the design, reliability, and evolution of the platform itself. You’ll make decisions that shape performance, define best practices, and ensure the workflows that Vercel, our customers, and their agents depend on are fast, resilient, and secure.

This role blends product thinking with deep systems ownership. You’ll partner with teams across Vercel to build and operate the agentic infrastructure that determines how software actually ships.

We’re looking for engineers who want to own high-scale systems end-to-end, thrive on improving the developer/agent experience, and are driven to have a lasting impact on how modern software gets built and delivered.

What You Will Do:

Own and evolve the infrastructure that powers Vercel’s build and deployment lifecycle — from handling webhooks to designing resilient database schemas and building scalable APIs.
Design and operate high-performance microservices that process millions of builds daily, ensuring speed, reliability, and developer delight.
Lead projects end-to-end: from identifying opportunities to defining technical direction and delivering improvements in performance, reliability, and developer experience.
Collaborate across teams to align infrastructure with company-wide goals and ensure seamless developer workflows.
Shape the long-term vision of agentic infrastructure at Vercel by setting standards for scalability, reliability, and developer productivity.
Participate in the on-call rotation, taking responsibility for the reliability of critical systems.
Contribute to the open-source community, representing Vercel’s commitment to advancing developer tools globally.
Write clean, efficient, tested, and well-documented code that others can build upon confidently.

About You:

3+ years of experience designing, building, and operating backend applications and distributed systems at scale.
Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to navigate and improve complex systems.
Strong proficiency with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and infrastructure as code (Terraform)
A track record of end-to-end ownership — from design and implementation through to long-term operation in production.
Skilled at cross-team collaboration, able to influence priorities and drive alignment toward shared goals.
Able to reason about technical direction and architectural tradeoffs, balancing long-term vision with pragmatic delivery.
Invested in the people around you — through mentorship, code review, or simply raising the bar on how the team builds.
Curious, eager to learn, and motivated to push the boundaries of how modern software gets built and shipped.

Bonus If You:

Are familiar with React or Next.js
Have experience with DynamoDB
Have worked to develop a CI/CD platform or internal developer platform used by other engineers or by agents.
Have experience contributing to, or participating in open-source projects.
Have experience optimizing build systems for monorepos or polyrepo setups.
Have experience with build caching, artifact storage, or dependency management at scale.

Benefits & Compensation:

Competitive compensation package, including equity.
Inclusive Healthcare Package.
Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
Flexible Time Off.
We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

The base pay range for this role is $196,000.00 - $294,000.00. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.

Disclosures:

Privacy: Please review our Job Applicant Privacy Policy for more information on how we handle your data.
Equal Opportunity: Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

jobs.description:
Title:
Actuarial Data Scientist
Location:
San Francisco Bay Area, CA / Austin, TX / Dallas, TX / Morristown, NJ (Flexible / Hybrid)
Reporting to:
Sr. Manager, Actuarial Data Science

Open to Relocation? We’ve Got You Covered:

This role is open to candidates willing to relocate to one of our hub locations. Hippo offers relocation assistance to support your move
, so you can focus on doing impactful work—not the logistics of getting here.

About Hippo:

Hippo was built on a promise: make homeownership effortless. Nearly a decade later, that mission still drives us. We use technology and data to help our customers stay ahead of problems and protect what matters most.
Today, that same tech-native approach powers our work beyond homeowners. Hippo operates as a diversified carrier platform, partnering with MGAs to deliver tailored program solutions that help them grow and deliver better customer experiences. Behind that work is a team that values ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
If you're energized by building what's next, we'd love to meet you.

About This Role:

We’re hiring an actuarial data scientist to lead loss cost modeling for Hippo’s Homeowners program. This role will own the design, development, and deployment of predictive models for frequency and severity, ensuring strong alignment with pricing strategy and business objectives. You’ll build and scale Python- and SQL-based tooling that embeds expected loss ratio and segmentation analytics into reusable, production-ready workflows. In addition to leading loss cost modeling, you’ll have the opportunity to expand the team’s modeling capabilities across demand and aggregation models to inform broader pricing and business mix decisions.

About You:

You are a hands-on leader with a strong background in loss modeling. You bring structure to ambiguity and enjoy building scalable work and collaborating with other teams. You think critically about model maintenance cost and you balance scientific rigor with practical business impact. You communicate clearly, document thoroughly, and operate with a strong sense of ownership.

What You’ll Do:

Lead homeowners insurance modeling efforts, setting clear priorities, technical standards, and best practices while fostering a culture of ownership, rigor, and continuous improvement
Own the design and annual build of our by-peril loss models
Expand modeling capabilities across conversion, retention, and aggregation to inform pricing strategy, business mix, and portfolio performance
Implement and scale models within our Airflow-based Python modeling pipeline, ensuring robust testing, validation, reproducibility, and long-term maintainability
Develop reusable analytical tooling and workflows that improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability across the actuarial team

new_jobs.description:
APPLIED AI ENGINEERING LEAD

Thresh Consulting — Strategy in Action for the AI Era

Salary: $190,000 – $235,000 + up to 25% performance-based bonus
Location: Hybrid (Denver, Chicago, or NYC preferred)

ABOUT THRESH

Thresh Consulting is a modern digital consulting firm built for the AI era—where strategy, execution, and craft come together to deliver real outcomes with speed. Our specialty is helping organizations design, build, and scale digital products that create exceptional customer experiences and drive value.

Our engineers are builders who work side by side with product & design. We value clarity over complexity, quality over shortcuts, and learning as a core part of growth.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Applied AI Engineering Lead turns ambition into production systems that move a client's business. You'll own the technical direction of our AI engagements: deciding which problems are worth solving with AI, architecting the solution, and leading the team that ships it. Your depth is in applied LLM engineering: agents, tool use, retrieval, evaluation, and the guardrails that make AI safe to put in front of customers. You're fluent enough across front end, APIs, data, and cloud to build an experience end-to-end yourself when it counts.

You'll spend about 70% of your time building and 30% leading. You'll guide a team of 2-4 engineers and serve as a primary partner to client engineering leaders. You'll also work with Thresh's practice leads to scope and shape new AI work.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Set technical direction for AI engagements

Partner with clients to identify and prioritize high-value AI use cases, and be clear about what's ready for production versus what's still a demo.
Architect end-to-end LLM solutions: model selection, prompting strategy, retrieval, agents and tool use, and the integrations that connect them to real systems.
Make build, buy, prompt, or fine-tune calls based on cost, latency, quality, and risk, and explain those calls to client leadership.
Shape scope, estimates, and technical approach for new AI engagements alongside Thresh's practice and sales leads.

Build AI-powered, customer-facing experiences

Build conversational shopping experiences where customers discover, compare, and buy through natural language, from first question to completed order.
Set the patterns for streaming interfaces that stay fast and readable under real load, including partial responses, tool-call states, errors, and graceful fallbacks.
Bring real business logic into the conversation: live pricing, inventory, promotions, personalization, and customer account context.

Build agents, tools, and integrations

Build for a client's own site and app and for third-party AI assistants like ChatGPT and Gemini, all from one shared foundation.
Build and extend MCP servers and tools that give models safe, structured access to catalog, pricing, cart, and order capabilities.
Prepare commerce systems for AI agents that shop on a customer's behalf, with structured product data, agent-ready checkout, and clear rules for what an agent can and can't do.
Work with emerging agentic commerce protocols (ACP, UCP), and know where each fits a client's business model.
Integrate with enterprise commerce, catalog, order, and identity systems that were never designed for AI.
Design multi-step agents and workflows that take real actions in client systems, with clear permissions, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and audit trails.
Build retrieval and knowledge systems (RAG) over client content, catalogs, and documentation, and tune them for accuracy.

Make AI trustworthy in production

Build guardrails that keep the assistant in scope. That means no fabricated prices, promises, or commitments, and a clean handoff to a person or standard flow when a request goes past what it should handle.
Own the evaluation strategy. Build eval sets and automated test harnesses covering clean queries, edge cases, out-of-scope requests, and prompt-injection attempts, and turn what you find into fixes and release gates.
Instrument conversations end to end for analytics, attribution, observability, cost, and latency, so clients can measure what the experience drives.
Prepare work for the legal, privacy, security, and brand reviews that every transactional AI experience goes through.
Monitor model quality, drift, and spend after launch, and plan for model upgrades and vendor changes without breaking the experience.

Champion Agentic Development

Make AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor) your default way of working.
Write specs precise enough for an agent to implement against, then verify the output against the spec rather than the diff.
Prototype conversational features in days with mock data, so clients can see the experience before the real integrations land.
Test new tools and workflows, and bring what works back to the team and to the wider Thresh practice.

Lead and elevate

Mentor engineers through code review, pairing, and technical guidance, across the full applied AI stack, from prompting and evals to production architecture.
Partner with product managers and designers on conversation design, scope, technical risk, and estimates.
Define the components, patterns, and standards that become reusable assets across Thresh's AI work, including reference architectures and starter kits.
Help build Thresh's applied AI capability through hiring input, technical interviews, and internal enablement.
Represent Thresh's AI point of view with clients and platform partners through workshops, technical content, and pre-sales conversations.

Deliver for clients

Own AI solutions from discovery through production deployment.
Explain progress and tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including what AI can and can't reliably do.
Work within each client's existing stack, frameworks, and constraints.
Hold the quality bar when deadlines tighten and requirements shift.

WHAT YOU BRING

Technical

7+ years building and shipping production software, including 2+ years shipping LLM-powered products to real users.
Strong working knowledge of React, TypeScript, and Next.js enough to build, review, and guide production UI work.
Shipped streaming or conversational UI in production, including tool-calling patterns and structured model output.
Experience building or consuming MCP servers, or a comparable tool-integration layer for LLMs.
Deep, hands-on experience with LLM APIs and agent frameworks (e.g., Claude, OpenAI, Gemini; agent SDKs, LangGraph, or similar), including prompting, tool use, structured output, and multi-step agents.
Built retrieval-augmented systems in production, including embeddings, chunking, vector or hybrid search, and accuracy tuning.
Designed and run LLM evaluation frameworks, and used the results to make shipping decisions.
Practical understanding of LLM security and risk: prompt injection, data leakage, PII handling, and responsible AI practices.
Can reason about model cost, latency, and quality tradeoffs, and make model selection calls that hold up.
Strong back-end skills in Python and/or Node.js. You can design and build the services and APIs your AI systems need.
API experience across REST and/or GraphQL, plus working fluency with PostgreSQL and NoSQL stores.
Working knowledge of cloud platforms and their AI services (e.g., AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI), CI/CD, and Docker.
Daily, hands-on use of AI coding agents in real work. Be ready to show us how you use them.
Bonus: e-commerce, checkout, or payments experience in a high-volume environment.
Bonus: fine-tuning, classical ML, or data engineering experience for when a problem calls for it.

How you work

You ship production systems on time and at a high standard.
You do well when requirements evolve and priorities shift.
You debug across layers, propose fixes, and make pragmatic tradeoffs.
You know when "good enough" is the right call and when to push for excellence.
You care about the details users notice, and the ones they don't.
You've led technical teams through delivery and helped other engineers grow
You explain technical concepts to non-engineers clearly.
You can tell a client when AI isn't the right answer, and explain why.
Client-facing or professional services experience is strongly preferred.

WHY THRESH

Senior-level competitive compensation with performance bonus upside.
Comprehensive healthcare benefits.
401(k) with company matching.
High ownership and influence over technical direction of Thresh's AI practice.
Hybrid delivery flexibility with client travel and team co-locations.
A low-ego culture built on clarity, craft, and outcomes.

new_jobs.description:
Description

At Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems (ASCS), our mission is to power the online buying experience for customers worldwide so they can find, discover, and buy any product they want. We innovate on behalf of our customers to ensure uniqueness and consistency of product identity and to infer relationships between products in Amazon Catalog to drive the selection gateway for the search and browse experiences on the website. We're solving a fundamental AI challenge: establishing product identity and relationships at unprecedented scale. Using Generative AI, Visual Language Models (VLMs), and multimodal reasoning, we determine what makes each product unique and how products relate to one another across Amazon's catalog. The scale is staggering: billions of products, petabytes of multimodal data, millions of sellers, dozens of languages, and infinite product diversity—from electronics to groceries to digital content.

The research challenges are immense. GenAI and VLMs hold transformative promise for catalog understanding, but we operate where traditional methods fail: ambiguous problem spaces, incomplete and noisy data, inherent uncertainty, reasoning across both images and textual data, and explaining decisions at scale. Establishing product identities and groupings requires sophisticated models that reason across text, images, and structured data—while maintaining accuracy and trust for high-stakes business decisions affecting millions of customers daily.

Amazon's Item and Relationship Platform group is looking for an innovative and customer-focused applied scientist to help us make the world's best product catalog even better. In this role, you will partner with technology and business leaders to build new state-of-the-art algorithms, models, and services to infer product-to-product relationships that matter to our customers. You will pioneer advanced GenAI solutions that power next-generation agentic shopping experiences, working in a collaborative environment where you can experiment with massive data from the world's largest product catalog, tackle problems at the frontier of AI research, rapidly implement and deploy your algorithmic ideas at scale, across millions of customers.

Key job responsibilities

Key Job Responsibilities Include

Formulate open research problems at the intersection of GenAI, multimodal reasoning, and large-scale information retrieval—defining the scientific questions that transform ambiguous, real-world catalog challenges into publishable, high-impact research
Push the boundaries of VLMs, foundation models, and agentic architectures by designing novel approaches to product identity, relationship inference, and catalog understanding—where the problem complexity (billions of products, multimodal signals, inherent ambiguity) demands methods that don't yet exist
Advance the science of efficient model deployment—developing distillation, compression, and LLM/VLM serving optimization strategies that preserve frontier-level multimodal reasoning in compact, production-grade architectures while dramatically reducing latency, cost, and infrastructure footprint at billion-product scale
Make frontier models reliable—advancing uncertainty calibration, confidence estimation, and interpretability methods so that frontier-scale GenAI systems can be trusted for autonomous catalog decisions impacting millions of customers daily
Own the full research lifecycle from problem formulation through production deployment—designing rigorous experiments over petabytes of multimodal data, iterating on ideas rapidly, and seeing your research directly improve the shopping experience for hundreds of millions of customers
Shape the team's research vision by defining technical roadmaps that balance foundational scientific inquiry with measurable product impact
Mentor scientists and engineers on advanced ML techniques, experimental design, and scientific rigor—building deep organizational capability in GenAI and multimodal AI
Represent the team in the broader science community—publishing findings, delivering tech talks, and staying at the forefront of GenAI, VLM, and agentic system research

Basic Qualifications

PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
2+ years of building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application experience

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with LLMs, VLMs, foundation models, or large-scale deep learning systems—including multimodal pretraining, fine-tuning, RLHF, prompt engineering, or agentic architectures
Experience with LLM/VLM serving optimization, including model distillation, quantization, pruning, speculative decoding, or other model compression and efficient inference techniques
Experience with explainable AI, model interpretability, or uncertainty quantification
Strong experimental design skills and statistical analysis expertise
Track record of deploying ML models at scale in production environments processing billions of data points
Publications in top-tier venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, EMNLP, ACL, NAACL, COLING, KDD, SIGMOD, WWW, AAAI, or similar
Excellent written, verbal communication & data presentation skills

new_jobs.description:
About Nscale

Nscale is taking on the hyperscalers by building a vertically integrated GenAI cloud platform. We own the data centers, software, and applications that power today's AI stack using sustainable technology solutions. We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As a Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Collaboration is key, and we work together swiftly and respectfully, embracing adaptability and resilience in all we do.

About The Role

Nscale is looking for a Principal AI Engineer (Specialised)
to lead the inference and post-training pillar of our AI systems engineering organization. You’ll define the multi-year technical roadmap for how models are served, evaluated, and post-trained on Nscale’s GPU cloud, across dedicated and serverless inference and bring-your-own-model deployments. You’ll lead the most consequential architectural programmes in that space and set the engineering standards that 20–50+ engineers build to.

As a Principal engineer, you are one of the deepest technical authorities in the company on AI systems. Your decisions set the cost, latency, and reliability at which Nscale serves tokens and runs post-training workloads, and those numbers have to compete with the world’s leading AI infrastructure providers. The problems span the full stack: kernel efficiency on state-of-the-art GPU systems, fleet-level KV cache and serving architecture, the evals that prove model quality, and RL loops where inference and training share hardware. You frame the solutions the organization executes against, including the API contracts customers see.

How We Work

Dog years. We move quickly and compress a lot of learning into a short time.
Don’t let perfect be the enemy of good. Ship, measure, iterate.
Be relentless. Own the problem end to end and see it through.
One team, one mission. Outcomes over process, and no “not my job”.

Responsibilities

Define and own the multi-year technical roadmap for Nscale’s inference, evals, and post-training platform, and translate it into architecture that multiple teams can execute against
Lead company-scale architectural initiatives in the pillar, such as next-generation serving (disaggregated prefill/decode, KV cache orchestration across GPU, host, and storage tiers, speculative decoding, multi-tenant scheduling), GPU kernel and model efficiency work (custom kernels, FP8/NVFP4/INT8/4 quantization, sparsity, distillation, MoE serving), evals and benchmarking frameworks, and post-training and RL infrastructure
Establish engineering standards adopted across all AI teams: API design and compatibility guarantees, benchmarking and evals methodology, training stability norms, and performance testing practices
Own the framework by which cost, latency, throughput, and model quality trade-offs are made and measured across the pillar
Identify long-horizon systemic risks early (serving engine and framework bets, accelerator support, capability gaps) and resolve them before they block the organization
Align AI engineering, research, product, and infrastructure leadership on multi-team technical strategy; frame technical trade-offs in product and commercial terms
Mentor and develop Staff and Senior AI Engineers, and grow the next generation of inference technical leaders at Nscale
Represent Nscale’s technical approach externally: open-source leadership in the frameworks we depend on, publications, conference talks, and partnerships with GPU vendors and AI labs

Requirements

10–15 years of engineering experience, with a clear track record of pillar-level impact on production AI systems
4+ years of hands-on work with LLMs in inference, GPU performance, evals, or post-training and RL, in production or research
Demonstrated ability to define multi-year technical strategy for complex, multi-team AI systems organizations
World-class depth in production LLM inference, GPU performance, evals, and/or post-training and RL infrastructure, with strong working knowledge across the rest
Demonstrated ownership of the architecture of a large-scale production inference or training platform
Proven ability to create architectural frameworks and engineering standards adopted across large engineering organizations
Deep understanding of the hardware/software boundary for AI accelerators: CUDA or ROCm, memory bandwidth and interconnect constraints, and distributed compute paradigms
Strong history of growing technical leaders (Staff and above) and multiplying technical capability across teams
External recognition in the AI systems community through research, open source, or industry contribution

Preferred

Prior experience at a top-tier AI lab or major hyperscaler AI infrastructure team
Maintainer or core contributor to a foundational inference, kernel, or RL framework (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, LMCache, FlashInfer, Triton, verl, OpenRLHF, TRL, DeepSpeed, Megatron-LM, etc.)
Hands-on depth in RL for LLMs (DPO/GRPO-style methods, reward modelling, multi-turn and tool-use RL) and the interaction between inference and training infrastructure
Experience defining developer API platforms adopted at scale by external developers
Deep experience with control plane / data plane architecture and cell-based deployment patterns in large-scale inference infrastructure
Published work in AI systems: MLSys, NeurIPS Systems Track, OSDI, EuroSys, SC, or equivalent
Experience with hardware-software co-design: custom accelerator kernels (CUDA, Triton), compiler-level optimization, AI hardware roadmap engagement
Experience defining pricing, SLO, and capacity models for a commercial inference product

new_jobs.title: Sr. AI Solution Architect
new_jobs.description:
Cohesity is a leader in AI-powered data security and management. Aided by an extensive ecosystem of partners, Cohesity makes it easy to secure, protect, manage, and get value from data — across the data center, edge, and cloud. Cohesity helps organizations defend against cybersecurity threats with comprehensive data security and management capabilities, including immutable backup snapshots, AI-based threat detection, monitoring for malicious behavior, and rapid recovery at scale.

We’ve been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design.

Join us on our mission to shape the future of our industry.

GAIA is Cohesity’s enterprise AI platform for unlocking the value of unstructured data across the Cohesity Data Cloud. It helps customers securely search, understand, summarize, and reason across current and historical enterprise information, while preserving permissions, provenance, and governance. GAIA also provides a foundation for agentic AI by making trusted enterprise context available to AI applications, copilots, and agents — helping customers move from simply protecting data to using it as a strategic source of intelligence and action.

Why Now

These are founding seats in Cohesity’s new AI Business Unit. GAIA is where the market is heading — enterprises secured their data with us; now they want to activate it for AI. You’ll help build the technical sales playbook on top of 13,600 existing customers and co-sell muscle from NVIDIA and the hyperscalers, proving what GAIA can do in the accounts that matter most. Ground floor, executive air cover from the GM of AI, and a partner ecosystem already generating pipeline.

You are the technical engine behind the AI sales motion. Paired with the Specialist Account Executive, AI, you own the technical win — the AE owns the commercial relationship and the number, and you make the technology real: architecture, demos, POCs, and the credibility to hold a technical room. This is a pre-sales, business-value, and consultative solutions role, not a hands-on production-engineering seat. You bring enough depth to design and defend a solution, and enough range to translate it into a value story an executive buys.

HOW YOU’LL SPEND YOUR TIME HERE:

Own the technical win in every GAIA deal you support — discovery, solution design, demos, and proof of value — partnered with the Specialist AE who owns the commercial close.
Be the AI subject-matter expert in the room on data architecture, RAG, deployment models, and where the risk sits — credible enough to hold a technical conversation with a CAIO, CDO, VP of AI, or their architects.
Design and deliver enterprise-grade AI/GenAI solutions integrated with Cohesity’s data security and management platform, leveraging our unique access to enterprise backup, archive, and unstructured data.
Architect retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions and build reference architectures, solution accelerators, and demos that connect Cohesity’s core strengths with emerging AI capabilities.
Lead technical workshops, POCs, and pilots that validate AI use cases across regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, public sector, legal) and turn a first proof point into a multi-phase plan.
Build executive-quality technical narratives — solution briefs, architecture diagrams, and business cases specific to the account, not a template with a logo swapped in.
Work the AI partner ecosystem — NVIDIA, the hyperscalers, and infrastructure OEMs — on joint solutions, technical co-sell, and reference architectures that accelerate deals.
Feed the field back into the roadmap — partner with Product and Engineering so what you learn in deals shapes what we build and how customers adopt it.
Support disciplined deal hygiene — accurate technical qualification, honest POC exit criteria, and forecasts the AE and the business can plan against.

WE’D LOVE TO TALK TO YOU IF YOU HAVE MANY OF THE FOLLOWING:

7+ years in solutions architecture, sales/pre-sales engineering, or technical consulting, including time supporting enterprise sales in a specialist or overlay capacity.
Hands-on experience designing and deploying generative AI systems — LLMs, embeddings, RAG, vector stores, and orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain/LlamaIndex).
Strong infrastructure background: enterprise storage (NAS/SAN/Object), backup/recovery platforms, and hybrid-cloud architectures — you understand what it takes to get a platform decision made.
Familiarity with Kubernetes/OpenShift and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) for deploying AI workloads.
Proficiency in Python and APIs for automation, integration, and ML workflows — enough to build a credible demo and debug a POC.
Working knowledge of security, governance, and compliance frameworks and how they intersect with AI and data protection.
Excellent communication skills — able to simplify complex AI + infrastructure concepts for both technical and executive audiences, and to hold a buying committee.
Comfort operating in a co-sell / specialist model — you drive the AI technical motion, the AE owns the commercial relationship, and you make that partnership work.
Bachelor’s degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, streamline workflows, and support decision making.
Professional English language proficiency for customer and internal communication.

WE ARE EXTRA EXCITED IF YOU HAVE ANY OF THE FOLLOWING:

Prior specialist or overlay SE experience at a data infrastructure, cloud, or AI platform vendor.
Experience validating AI use cases in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, public sector, legal).
Comfort working a technical co-sell motion with NVIDIA, AWS, Azure, or GCP field and solutions teams.
Existing technical relationships with data/AI architecture leaders at Fortune 500 or high-growth East Coast enterprises.

HOW YOU WILL BE MEASURED:

Technical win rate on the deals you support — POCs and pilots that hit their exit criteria and convert.
Influenced revenue and pipeline progression across product, infrastructure, and consulting/advisory bookings in your territory.
Quality and reuse of the assets you produce — reference architectures, demos, and accelerators the broader field can run with.
Services and multi-phase attach — labs, deployment, and advisory engagements that grow the account.
Field collaboration — how well you and your paired AE(s) operate as a unit; AE and account-team satisfaction.
Partner co-sell — joint solutions and technical wins built with AI partner teams.
Technical qualification quality and POC/forecast reliability.

TRAVEL

Field-based, East Coast; regular travel across North America for customer meetings, workshops, and POCs, plus periodic travel to Santa Clara HQ and company events.

new_jobs.title: Founding / Principal Engineer, Trust & Control Infrastructure for AI Agents
new_jobs.description:
Stealth · San Francisco · Hybrid, 1–2 days a week in person to start · Q4 2026
Join the Founding Engineer Team at a founder-funded AI trust infrastructure company. Working prototype in review and test, development partners next, pre-seed/seed financing in progress, founder has gone founding-to-IPO before.

THE PROBLEM
Agents are being handed real authority. They approve refunds, move records between systems, change production configuration, and negotiate with other agents. Today no one can prove what an agent saw, what it decided, or what it did, and watching an agent is not the same as verifying it.
What an agent is shown decides what it does. That makes an agent's context and its decisions an attack surface nobody owns a control point over. Humans and systems need to constrain, correct, and sign off on agent decisions, before and after the fact, not just observe them. And none of this can depend on one framework or one model: a fleet built on LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, the OpenAI Agents SDK, the Anthropic Agent SDK, Google ADK, and MCP needs one independent standard underneath all of them.
We are building that standard: the way any agentic deployment, from a team's first ten agents to an enterprise's ten thousand, gains control over and insight into what its agents do, and puts them into production quickly, with trust and confidence.
How we do it stays under wraps until the development-partner phase. What it solves is above.

WHAT YOU WILL BUILD
• The framework integration layer. Our product running with at least two of the frameworks above, with identical guarantees, within your first quarter.
• The verification path. A design partner's security team can verify an agent's decisions end-to-end without us in the room.
• The control surface. How a human or a policy engine constrains, corrects, and signs off on an agent's decision, and how that holds when the agent is fast and the human is not.
• The performance envelope. Guarantees that cost agents milliseconds, not seconds. Measured, and published.
• The production stack. A working prototype exists and is in review and test. You review it, test it, and design the world-class production stack from it: your choices of languages, services, testing, agent tooling, and on-call become how we work.

WHAT YOU BRING
Background
• Six or more years building distributed systems or data infrastructure in production; you have owned a service other teams depended on. In the last two years part of that surface has been agentic: tool-calling models, agent runtimes, or MCP servers that other engineers' agents consume.
• Real time in at least one of: data infrastructure (databases, event streams, historians, ledgers), security or integrity engineering, observability, tracing, and audit systems, or developer platforms. Lineage from a company whose product was the record other systems trusted counts double; so does a team that shipped an agent product to real users and lived with what it did.
• Founding or pre-scale stage, or scaled a team from a handful to dozens, and you can say what you would do differently now that agents do a share of the engineering.

Systems experience (must have)
• You have built a system of record: an append-only, event-sourced, or ledger-style store where history is immutable, replay is deterministic, and people outside your team relied on it as the truth. You know what that guarantee costs, where it breaks, and what "deterministic" has to mean when a model is in the loop.
• Cryptographic integrity in practice: hashing, signing, content addressing, verification by a party who was not there. You designed for key rotation and algorithm change up front rather than bolting it on.
• Data lifecycle under constraint: deletion or retention designed into a system that also had to stay verifiable (regulatory erasure, legal hold, audit). You have lived the tension between "immutable" and "must be forgotten," including for what an agent was shown, not only what it wrote.
• A developer-facing surface you were accountable for: an SDK, library, API, or MCP server that other engineers, and their agents, build on, with versioning discipline, backward compatibility, and an upgrade path you owned.
• AI-native in production: a model or agent is a production component in something you shipped. You have written evals, handled non-determinism, built guardrails and human-in-the-loop approval paths, traced an agent's tool calls end to end, and dealt with prompt injection. Production experience with at least one of LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, the OpenAI Agents SDK, the Anthropic Agent SDK, Google ADK, or MCP.
• AI-native in practice: you build with coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or the like) writing, testing, and reviewing code under your direction, and you are judged on what ships, not on what you typed.
• Fluent in Python and TypeScript.

Strong signal
• Standards and protocol work: you have shipped against an evolving spec (MCP, A2A, OpenTelemetry's GenAI conventions, an IETF draft).
• Multi-tenant from day one: tenancy and permission boundaries for people and for the agents acting on their behalf.
• Shipped into a regulated or audited environment (finance, health, government, defense), built for an auditor who actually reads it.

The founding-era bar
• Moxie. You take the hard path when it is the right one, you ship under uncertainty with a small team, and you own the outcome, not the ticket.
• Intelligence. You reason from first principles, you write the design down before you prompt the agents, and you change your mind on evidence.
• Ambition. You want to set the standard an industry adopts, not fill a seat. If you would choose this over a lab offer, your three sentences should say why.
• Signal awareness. You know which three things on the board change the outcome this week and which twenty are noise, and you say so out loud, including when the founder has it wrong.
And you can be in San Francisco one to two days a week to start, with the rest remote: already in the Bay Area.

HOW WE WORK
• San Francisco, in person one to two days a week to start, remote the rest. The frameworks, the model labs, and most of the developers we are building for are within a few miles of each other here. Office location shared at the first call.
• AI-native by default. We use agents to build the thing that governs agents, and you are judged on what you ship.
• You would be one of the first three engineers. You work directly with the founder, a repeat enterprise-software operator who has scaled teams from founding stage through IPO and acquisitions, and with the founding engineer.
• Decisions in days, not quarters. Founder-funded through the prototype; pre-seed/seed financing in progress.
• Stealth now. A development-partner test phase precedes the public developer launch.

COMPENSATION
• Base salary: $190,000–$260,000. This is the pay scale we reasonably expect to pay for this position, set in good faith; where you land depends on demonstrated depth.
• Founding equity, sized to experience and scope. Four-year vest, one-year cliff, monthly thereafter.
• Benefits: medical, dental, and vision coverage; 401(k); flexible paid time off.

HOW WE HIRE
Step 1: a 30-minute conversation with the founder.
Step 2: a 60-minute technical deep dive on something you built that had to scale. Your choice.
Step 3: working together, or proceed. After the deep dive we decide together: a working session in San Francisco to meet and ideate on a real problem, with the prototype in front of you and under NDA, or, when the fit is already clear on both sides, straight to step 4.
Step 4: references, then offer. The process moves as fast as fit and mutual alignment allow.
A working-together path. This seat is critical and it is a partnership, so there is a second way in: begin by meeting and ideating with us before either of us commits to the full-time founding seat. Say in your application which path you want.

HOW TO APPLY
If you already know how you would build this, tell us. Send one artifact that shows scale design or models-in-the-loop work (a repo, a design doc, a postmortem, a talk), three sentences on why this problem, and your LinkedIn profile saved as a PDF (on your profile: More → Save to PDF), to opportunity@stealthaitrust.ai with the subject line "Founding Engineer — San Francisco". No cover letter.
